description: This Java source file defines the 'DatatableUtil' service class in the Apache Fineract project. It provides utility methods for handling data tables, including validation, entity resolution, data retrieval, and data scoping within the context of the platform's data query infrastructure.

classes.name: DatatableUtil
classes.description: A utility service class providing methods for validating, resolving, and retrieving data related to data tables within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: isMultirowDatatable
methods.description: Checks if the given list of column headers indicates a multi-row data table by searching for a specific named column.

methods.name: getFKField
methods.description: Returns the foreign key column name associated with a given entity table.

methods.name: validateDatatableRegistered
methods.description: Validates that the given data table name is registered in the system, throwing exceptions if invalid.

methods.name: validateDatatableName
methods.description: Validates the format and regex compliance of a data table name.

methods.name: resolveEntity
methods.description: Resolves an entity name string to an 'EntityTables' enum, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: queryForApplicationEntity
methods.description: Retrieves the application table name associated with a registered data table and resolves it to an 'EntityTables' enum.

methods.name: checkMainResourceExistsWithinScope
methods.description: Checks if a main resource exists within the user's data scope, returning processing results or throwing exceptions.

methods.name: dataScopedSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL query strings that restrict data access according to the user's office hierarchy and entity type.

methods.name: getOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL join condition for office hierarchy based on a join alias.

methods.name: getGroupOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL join condition for group hierarchy.

methods.name: getClientOfficeJoinCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL join condition for client hierarchy.

methods.name: retrieveDataTableGenericResultSet
methods.description: Fetches and constructs a generic result set for a data table, supporting optional ordering and filtering by ID.
